certifications.proof_quote: the California Student Online Personal Information Protection Act (SOPIPA) and other US state education privacy laws

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.source: Not mentioned on vendor's own trust center or security pages as of 2026-06-27.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.source: Appeared in a third-party summary but not confirmed on Kahoot's own trust center pages. Not included in vendor's self-disclosed certifications.

privacy.ai_training_note: Trust center explicitly states: 'We don't use end user data to train AI.' AI features page confirms: 'No data from the Kahoot! platform is used to train or refine any models.' Kahoot uses Microsoft Azure OpenAI as its primary AI provider; Microsoft assures that user data are not available to other customers or used to improve OpenAI models. AI features are opt-in and administrator-controlled.
privacy.data_region: Long-term storage of personal data is hosted on servers in the EU and Canada (primary). Additional regional processing nodes in USA, Australia, and Japan for performance optimization. Sub-processors include AWS Europe (Luxembourg), Google Cloud EU/Canada (Dublin), Aiven (Finland), OVH Canada, and Hetzner (Germany).

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES-256 or equivalent; customer data encrypted with industry best practices in production environment.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS v1.2 or higher for all network communication; SSL implementation rated 'A' by Qualys SSL Labs.

security.name: Penetration Testing
security.value: Continuous penetration testing conducted by an independent third party; detailed written report issued annually and available to enterprise customers on request.

security.name: Bug Bounty / Vulnerability Disclosure
security.value: Responsible disclosure program via security@kahoot.com, with safe harbor for compliant researchers. Kahoot works with Intigriti for continuous bug bounty testing. No monetary rewards offered. Full policy at kahoot.com/disclosure-policy.txt.

security.name: Backups
security.value: Multiple backup strategies; all backups encrypted and stored at separate geographic locations; retention up to six months.

security.name: Security Policy Review
security.value: Security policies reviewed annually and approved by senior management.

security.name: Data in Dev/Test Environments
security.value: Development environments never use real customer data.

security.name: Data Transfer Mechanism (Cross-Border)
security.value: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) used for transfers outside EU/EEA/UK. All sub-processors outside those regions must sign SCCs.

products.name: Kahoot! for Students, Teachers & Individuals
products.data_scope: Minimal data collected. Students who join via PIN require only a nickname (no account, no email). Teacher accounts collect contact details, usage data, and student progress. No third-party ads, no profiling for advertising.
products.notes: FERPA, COPPA, SOPIPA, GDPR compliant. Common Sense Privacy and 1EdTech certified. Subscription from $3/mo. Free tier available.

products.name: Kahoot! for Business / Enterprise
products.data_scope: Professional user data including employee contact details, engagement metrics, presentation analytics. SSO, roster sync, and data deletion controls available. Enterprise Agreement replaces standard T&C.
products.notes: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 apply here. DPA available. Annual pen test report provided to enterprise customers. Pricing from $19/mo; enterprise pricing negotiated.

products.name: Kahoot! for Higher Education
products.data_scope: Similar to the school product but with institutional licensing. FERPA and GDPR controls apply. LTI integration (1EdTech certified) for LMS connectivity.
products.notes: Student data processed as a processor on behalf of institution.

products.name: Kahoot! for Kids / Home / Social
products.data_scope: Children's plans restrict group features and social sharing. No ads. PIN-based participation does not require personal data from child players.
products.notes: COPPA compliant. Children's Privacy section in Privacy Notice.

products.name: Actimo / Motimate (subsidiary brands)
products.data_scope: Separate products for mobile employee engagement and company communications. Data scope governed by enterprise agreements.
products.notes: Listed as 'For Businesses' solutions on kahoot.com. Separate product line from core Kahoot.

products.name: Whiteboard.fi (subsidiary)
products.data_scope: Separate product for classroom whiteboard collaboration. Integrated into the Kahoot school ecosystem.

products.name: Drops (subsidiary)
products.data_scope: Standalone mobile language learning app. Consumer product with its own data practices.
products.notes: Listed under 'For Students' and 'For Family and Friends' on kahoot.com.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium + subscription tiers. Individual from $3/mo; Business from $19/mo. Enterprise pricing negotiated via sales. Free tier available with limited features.
compare.data_residency: EU and Canada primary (long-term storage); additional processing in USA, Australia, Japan for performance. SCCs used for non-EU transfers.

flags: Bug bounty program is a VDP-style responsible disclosure (no monetary rewards); researchers submit to security@kahoot.com or via Intigriti; confirm scope before assuming full bounty payout.
FedRAMP certification appeared in one third-party summary but is NOT listed on Kahoot's own trust center and should not be listed as a held certification without vendor confirmation.
Data transfers outside EU/EEA/UK are possible (e.g., US/Australia/Japan nodes); mitigated by SCCs. Relevant for customers with strict EU data residency requirements.
Drops and Whiteboard.fi are separate subsidiary products with potentially different data practices; enterprises should review those policies independently.
